Bengal CM cautions private universities against treating education as commodity

West Bengal's Chief Minister has issued a warning to private universities, urging them not to view education as a mere commodity driven by investment returns. The statement emphasizes the importance of education as a service rather than a product for profit. This directive highlights a potential tension between the commercial interests of private institutions and the perceived public good of education.
